description: lreview benchmark: merged Lustre changes whose bugs a later commit fixed (its Fixes: trailer names the change), plus controls with no known bug. Each bug has a summary for the LLM judge and regex match sets: a finding matches a set when it matches every pattern in it. Sets: 'quick' is a few cheap cases with reliable hits, for cost checks and quick verification; 'eval' is every validated case.

cases.subject: LU-5896 mdt: allow clients with old mdc_swap_layouts

bugs.fix_subject: LU-5896 mdt: do not overwrite the actual buffer size
bugs.summary: swabber_dumper_helper() sets len = rmf_size for every non-array field before calling the field's rmf_swab_len swabber. The new RMF_F_MINIMUM_SIZE field RMF_SWAP_LAYOUTS therefore always reaches lustre_swab_swap_layouts() with the 8-byte minimum, never the real buffer length, so msl_dv1/msl_dv2 of a 24-byte request are never swabbed for an opposite-endian peer.

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20117 mdc: fix RMF_SWAP_LAYOUTS packing
bugs.summary: mdc_ioc_swap_layouts() calls req_capsule_set_size(RMF_SWAP_LAYOUTS, 24) after mdc_prep_elc_req() has already packed the request. set_size does not resize or move packed buffers, so copying the 24-byte struct into the 8-byte RMF_SWAP_LAYOUTS buffer overwrites the start of the following RMF_DLM_REQ (the ELC cancel data).

bugs.fix_subject: LU-18687 compat: fix shrinker_debug_init/fini #ifdef
bugs.summary: In include/lustre_compat/linux/shrinker.h, the ORIGINAL commit moved the shrinker_debugfs_init/fini declarations from linux-misc.h (guarded by #ifndef CONFIG_SHRINKER_DEBUG) into the branch guarded by `!defined(CONFIG_SHRINKER_DEBUG) || defined(HAVE_REGISTER_SHRINKER_FORMAT_NAMED)`. The inline no-op stubs sit in the #else branch and are only defined when CONFIG_SHRINKER_DEBUG is set and HAVE_REGISTER_SHRINKER_FORMAT_NAMED is not. The guard no longer matches the one around the implementation in linux-prim.c, so on some kernel configs the functions are declared when they should be stubs, or the stubs and real definitions conflict or are missing. This causes compilation errors. Also, linux-prim.c (cfs_arch_init) relies on these declarations but the commit did not make it include shrinker.h, and libcfs.h no longer pulls it in via the removed include chain.

cases.subject: LU-19580 gss: refresh context vs LBUG upon gss error for LDLM

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19580 gss: refresh context vs LBUG upon gss error for LDLM
bugs.summary: In the ORIGINAL change to lustre/ptlrpc/sec.c:sptlrpc_req_refresh_ctx(), the new refresh branch also fires when `rc2 == -ENODATA`, the return value of sptlrpc_req_replace_dead_ctx(), and not only when gc_gss_err is GSS_S_NO_CONTEXT. When the ctx is DEAD and cannot be replaced, the code clears PTLRPC_CTX_ERROR_BIT, drops the sec ref and does `goto again` for any request with timeout == MAX_SCHEDULE_TIMEOUT. The same dead ctx is then retried, fails replacement again, and loops, so it can spin or hang indefinitely and never set rq_err. The fix removes the `rc2` / `-ENODATA` condition and keeps only the GSS_S_NO_CONTEXT check. The ORIGINAL also dereferences ctx2gctx(ctx)->gc_gss_err without checking that the ctx is a GSS ctx.

cases.subject: LU-18024 quota: relate qmt_lvbo_free_wq and QMT

bugs.fix_subject: LU-18024 quota: fix the order of freeing qmt_lvbo_free_wq
bugs.summary: In qmt_dev.c:qmt_device_fini the ORIGINAL change moves the workqueue into struct qmt_device but keeps the destroy_workqueue(qmt->qmt_lvbo_free_wq) and NULL assignment at the very start of shutdown, before qmt_pool_fini() and the namespace/lock cleanup. Those later steps release ldlm resources and invoke qmt_lvbo_free(), which does queue_work(qmt->qmt_lvbo_free_wq, ...). Because the workqueue was already destroyed and set to NULL, queue_work() is called on a destroyed/NULL workqueue, causing a crash/use-after-free, and pending lvbo-free work for lqe entries is lost (leak). The workqueue must be destroyed only after all possible users have finished cleanup.

cases.subject: LU-20438 lnd: Support PCI P2P DMA mapping

bugs.fix_subject: LU-20438 lnd: fix EFA P2P configure guard
bugs.summary: In lnet/klnds/efalnd/efalnd.c:kefalnd_startup, the ORIGINAL commit guards the ni->ni_p2pdma initialisation with IN_KERNEL_HAVE_OFED_IB_DMA_PCI_P2P_DMA_SUPPORTED, a macro that is only emitted by the o2ib configure check (LN_CONFIG_O2IB). In a --disable-o2ib --enable-efa build the macro is never defined, so the #ifdef block compiles out and ni_p2pdma stays clear on an EFA NI whose device does support PCI P2P DMA, so P2P/GPU DMA is not advertised or used for efalnd. cases.subject: LU-14554 lfs: Return error for verify when stale components exist

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19527 lfs: fix resync with nosync+stale components
bugs.summary: The ORIGINAL change makes `lfs mirror verify` count every LCME_FL_STALE component as an error (print_stale_mirrors() in lustre/utils/lfs.c returns stale_count, and lfs_mirror_verify_file() sets rc2 = -ESTALE), without excluding components that are both stale and LCME_FL_NOSYNC. Nosync+stale components are intentionally skipped by resync (llapi_mirror_find_stale), so they can never be made non-stale; verify then returns ESTALE and `lfs mirror resync` (which runs verify afterward) fails on files with nosync+stale components such as EC parity mirrors. lfs_mirror_prepare_chunk() also does not skip nosync components, so they are included in chunk verification.

cases.subject: LU-19183 quota: enforce file quota for root_prj_quota

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19791 quota: fix silent data loss for root project
bugs.summary: In osd_declare_inode_qid (osd-ldiskfs/osd_quota.c) and osd_declare_quota (osd-zfs/osd_quota.c), the ORIGINAL change makes root-project-quota (QUOTA_FL_ROOT_PRJQUOTA) override the force/ignore-quota flag for block quota, so force = th->th_ignore_quota applies and OSD_QID_FORCE is effectively nullified when root_prj_enable is set. It does this for all block writes, including OBD_BRW_ASYNC lnbs flushed from the client cache in osd_declare_write_commit. When root is over the project quota (e.g. from another client), these already-acknowledged buffered pages are rejected with -EDQUOT at write commit and dropped, causing silent data loss. The write path needed a way to ignore the root-prj check for ASYNC pages (later OSD_QID_IGNORE_ROOT_PRJ).

cases.subject: LU-19475 kfilnd: GDS support for kfilnd

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19796 kfilnd: fix sg_table free after orig_nents overwrite
bugs.summary: In lnet/klnds/kfilnd/kfilnd_tn.c:kfilnd_tn_set_sgl_buf(), the ORIGINAL change allocates the sg_table with sg_alloc_table(max_nkiov) and then overwrites tn->tn_sgt.orig_nents with sg_count (the number of populated segments) before DMA mapping. kfilnd_tn_free() later calls sg_free_table() on that table, which relies on orig_nents being the original allocation size to decide whether to free chained pages or just kfree(); with the shrunken value it mis-frees the table, producing free_nonslab_page() warnings and potentially leaking or corrupting memory. The original allocation size is never saved, so it cannot be restored before sg_free_table().

bugs.fix_subject: LU-19496 kfilnd: Fix error handling in DMA mapping
bugs.summary: In kfilnd_tn.c:kfilnd_tn_set_sgl_buf() (added by the ORIGINAL commit), the return value of lnet_rdma_map_sg_attrs()/dma_map_sgtable() is not checked before setting tn->tn_sgt_mapped = true and populating tn_num_iovec from tn_sgt.nents. If DMA mapping fails, the function proceeds as if mapped, so the failed table is later passed to kfilnd_ep_post_*() and then unmapped via lnet_rdma_unmap_sg()/dma_unmap_sgtable() in kfilnd_tn_finalize() (unmapping something never mapped). On the failing path the caller also calls kfilnd_tn_free(), and the error return leaves state inconsistent (also GPU path can leave nents unset when rc==0). Fix checks rc<0, frees the sg_table and returns before setting tn_sgt_mapped.

cases.subject: LU-11509 ldlm: replace client lock LRU with LFRU

bugs.fix_subject: LU-11509 ldlm: fix lfru priv_ratio_limit overflow issue
bugs.summary: In the ORIGINAL change, `ns_lfru_priv_ratio_limit_256` is declared `__s8` in struct ldlm_namespace (lustre_dlm.h) but is assigned values up to 255 (default 30*256/100=76, but sysfs `lru_priv_ratio_limit_store` in ldlm_resource.c accepts any int and stores `tmp * 256 / 100` unchecked). Values above ~50% overflow to negative, and `ldlm_lfru_priv_too_many` (ldlm_cache_policy.c) multiplies `ns_nr_unused * ratio` and shifts, so a negative ratio or a 32-bit overflow yields a wrong/garbage threshold, causing the priv list to be demoted incorrectly or never. The store handler also lacks any range validation (negative or >100 values accepted).

bugs.fix_subject: LU-16446 utils: fix issues with llapi_get_lmm_from_path()
bugs.summary: The ORIGINAL commit adds llapi_get_lmm_from_path() in liblustreapi.c and its use in lfs.c:lfs_setstripe_internal (-N=TOTAL mode).
